events.body:
## Context

`docs/assets/js/include.js` fails `node --check` with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'` at line 93: lines 80-93 are a leftover copy of `wireDocLinks`'s second loop plus an extra brace (likely a bad merge). `loadIncludes()` never runs, so the sidebar and `data-asset-src` images are missing on 21 pages.

## What to do

1. Delete the orphaned lines 80-93 (the same logic is already inside `wireDocLinks`).
2. Optional: add a smoke-test row to `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`: `blt-design\tnode\tfor f in docs/assets/js/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `node --check docs/assets/js/include.js` passes
- [ ] Sidebar renders on `/index.html` and `/docs/components/buttons.html`
- [ ] Current page has `aria-current="page"`
- [ ] No console errors

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-design && python3 -m http.server 8765   # open /index.html and /docs/components/buttons.html
```

---
